4) Procurement timing: any procurement windows or finance cycles we should align to?

Next steps from Redwood:
- I’ll draft a pricing summary for the expected token band and call out ramp discounts and dedicated capacity commitments.
- We’ll include suggested unit economics and a rough estimate of total cost (monthly / annual).
- If you can introduce the finance/procurement contact (or confirm the budget owner), we’ll prepare a short justification doc for them.

Attachments: Finex_MAAP_v1.xlsx (your usage worksheet), Redwood_Pricing_Summary.pdf (template) — I attached the pricing template so you can see how we map tokens to tiers.

If it helps I can target a one-pager with 3 scenarios (conservative / base / aggressive) and a recommended price band (we’ll propose a $/1M tokens target to share with Finance).

Thanks — looking forward to the numbers so we can move pricing to Procurement.
